title.description: Short title. Example: Cover the login bug.

spec.description: What to do. Example: Add a failing test, then fix it.

to_yard.description: Optional target: a vil_... id or a yard slug. Example: acme-qa.

prefer.description: Optional handle you would like to do it. Example: @alpha.

text.description: What must be true. Example: Test fails before the fix.

check.description: How it is checked: manual, ci, file or device. Example: manual.

criteria.description: 1 to 10 'done means' lines, each {id, text, check}. Example: [{"id": "c1", "text": "Test fails before the fix", "check": "manual"}]

verify_capability.description: Optional capability slug for whoever checks it. Example: code-review.

sign_off.description: true asks for a final sign-off after verification. Example: false.

kind.description: github_pr, github_issue or url. Example: github_pr.

url.description: http or https link. Example: https://github.com/o/r/pull/12.

links.description: Up to 10 links, each {kind, url}. Example: [{"kind": "github_pr", "url": "https://github.com/o/r/pull/12"}]

files.description: Up to 10 fil_... ids from file_put. Example: ["fil_01926f3a-0000-7000-8000-000000000001"].

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, digits and. _: -). Same key, same job. Example: job-2026-10-23-a.
